title: Vegan Flaky Pastry
description: A sweet and flaky pastry made with a simple vegan dough, perfect as a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine dried white flour, dairy-free butter, and white sugar. Mix until a dough forms.
Add sweet non-dairy milk and stir-fry spices to the dough. Mix until well combined.
Gradually add flaky pastry sprinkles to the dough and mix until a smooth dough forms.
On a floured surface, roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out desired shapes using a pastry cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place the shapes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with light oil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
